links.outcome: Hallucination rates of LLM responses to scabies patient questions
links.effect: Hallucination rates differed significantly among models (p = 0.003), with DeepSeek exhibiting higher rates.
links.quote: There were significant differences in hallucination rates among the models (p = 0.003), with DeepSeek exhibiting higher rates.

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of LLM scabies patient education responses
links.effect: ChatGPT-5.2 had the highest readability (FRES 63.25 ± 11.5); statistically significant differences in readability across models, with Claude Sonnet 4.5 scoring lower on most metrics.
links.quote: In this study, it was found that ChatGPT-5.2 demonstrated the highest information quality (mDISCERN: 33.6 ± 1.8) and readability (FRES: 63.25 ± 11.5).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of responses from multiple LLMs to scabies questions using standardized quality, accuracy, readability, and hallucination metrics without testing an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
